subject: Follow-up after demo: IAM evidence & vendor questionnaire — next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Baxter <anna.baxter@stargazehealth.com>, Stargaze Health Security <security@stargazehealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T15:12:00Z
Subject: Follow-up after demo: IAM evidence & vendor questionnaire — next steps

Hi Anna (and security team),

Thanks again for your time on today’s demo. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep procurement moving: 

- Demo highlights: SAML SSO with just-in-time provisioning via SCIM, role-based access controls (RBAC) for team-level privileges, admin activity logs with exportable audit trails, and our regional deployment controls.
- Compliance snapshot: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in May 2026 (scope: production inference platform + control plane). We also maintain a DPA with a HIPAA BAA option for customers that require it. I can send the redacted report and DPA link as part of the initial evidence pack.

Action items I propose:
1) I’ll send an initial evidence bundle with SSO/SCIM integration notes, enumerated RBAC controls, and our SOC 2 summary.
2) You (security) to share Stargaze’s vendor security questionnaire and any preferred upload method for sensitive artifacts.
3) Schedule a short technical kickoff between your infra/security and our security/engineering (30 min).

Attachments: Redwood-Security-Brief-2026.pdf (overview). Also linking our SSO integration guide: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodSSOGuide

If that plan looks good, I’ll loop in Ben (solutions engineer) and Rishi (security lead) and get the evidence pack out by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,

—
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

[Attachment: Redwood-Security-Brief-2026.pdf (pdf)]

From: Anna Baxter <anna.baxter@stargazehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stargaze Health Security <security@stargazehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@stargazehealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up after demo: IAM evidence & vendor questionnaire — next steps

Hi Soojin,

Appreciate the recap — the demo was helpful. Attaching our vendor security questionnaire so you can provide answers where applicable. A few immediate clarifications we need: 

- SOC 2: is the report public or redacted? Please include the report date and which systems are in scope (control plane, inference runtime, customer data storage).
- HIPAA: do you offer a BAA and is that included in your DPA?
- Data residency: we need confirmation you can commit to hosting customer keys and PHI in us-east-1 only (or provide a plan).
- IAM evidence: for our initial review we typically ask for:
  * SAML metadata or IdP integration notes
  * SCIM endpoint documentation (endpoints, auth method, rate limits)
  * Description of RBAC model and how admin accounts are provisioned/audited
  * Latest pen test summary or plan to provide it

Please attach whatever you can. We prefer receiving sensitive artifacts through our secure SFTP or internal SharePoint — see the last page of the attached doc for upload instructions.

Thanks — procurement will also review and reach out on contracting cadence.

Anna Baxter
Head of InfoSec Operations | Stargaze Health
anna.baxter@stargazehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-4472

[Attachment: Vendor-Security-Questionnaire-Stargaze.docx (docx)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Baxter <anna.baxter@stargazehealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-09T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up after demo: IAM evidence & vendor questionnaire — next steps

Hi Anna — Ben here (solutions engineering). I pulled together the initial evidence pack and answers to the questionnaire where straightforward. High level answers below; I attached the full bundle (IDAccess-Pack-Redwood.zip) with configuration examples and redacted reports.

SOC 2 / Compliance:
- SOC 2 Type II completed: May 12, 2026 (redacted report included in bundle). In scope: control plane, inference runtime, authentication/authorization services and logging pipelines.
- Pen test: most recent external penetration test completed March 2026; executive summary included in the bundle (full report available under NDA).
- HIPAA: we offer a BAA; the template BAA is part of our DPA and I’ve included the DocuSign placeholder for your procurement team (DocuSign: 0xA1B2C3-BAA).

IAM specifics included in the bundle:
- SAML: metadata XML and a short IdP integration checklist (SAML metadata, ACS URL, NameID formats supported).
- SCIM: endpoints documented (PATCH/PUT users, /Groups), token-based auth (Bearer), and our recommended rate limits (60 req/min per org).
- RBAC: description of built-in roles (viewer, editor, admin, super-admin), custom role mapping via SCIM group sync, and admin activity audit logs (immutable exportable CSV).
- Admin controls: MFA requirement for admin roles, MFA via TOTP or corporate SSO, admin account approval workflow (two-approver flow supported).

Attachments inside IDAccess-Pack-Redwood.zip:
- soc2-redacted-summary.pdf
- scim-endpoints.md
- saml-metadata.xml
- rbac-matrix.csv
- pen-test-exec-summary.pdf

Upload options: we can upload to your secure SFTP or place the package into a secure SharePoint link if you share a destination. For anything that requires NDA access (full SOC or pen test), let us know and we’ll route through your preferred secure channel.

Next steps: happy to book a 30-minute technical sync early next week (we’re available Tue/Wed mornings PDT).

Regards,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

[Attachment: IDAccess-Pack-Redwood.zip (zip)]

From: Anna Baxter <anna.baxter@stargazehealth.com>

Cc: Stargaze Health Security <security@stargazehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@stargazehealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-10T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up after demo: IAM evidence & vendor questionnaire — next steps

Ben / Soojin — this is perfect, thank you. The bundle covers exactly what we needed for initial triage.

Two quick asks:
1) Please send the BAA via DocuSign to procurement@stargazehealth.com and copy me.
2) We’d like to schedule the technical kickoff with our infra/security teams; can you do Tue 2026-07-14 10:00 AM ET (that’s 07:00 PT)? If not, propose two alternate slots.

Per our upload instructions, I’m attaching the secure upload guide. For any full reports under NDA we’ll provide an SFTP account and temporary creds once procurement confirms the engagement.

Thanks again — looking forward to the kickoff.

Anna
